Before we talk
What information is helpful?+

Your objective, target systems or environment, preferred timeline, and any compliance or customer requirements are useful starting points. Do not include passwords or sensitive credentials.

Can we request an NDA?+

Yes. Mention it in your enquiry so confidentiality requirements can be handled before detailed scoping.

Do you support urgent incidents?+

Use the email link above with “Urgent security incident” in the subject. Availability should be confirmed directly before relying on CyWareGroups for emergency response.
